#!/bin/bash
# Auto-generated by Infrahub - do not edit by hand.
# VM: fra1-vm-cache01
# Host: fra1-kvm-02
# Cluster: FRA1-KVM-CLUSTER (kvm)
set -euo pipefail

IMAGES=/var/lib/libvirt/images
if [ ! -f "$IMAGES/tpl-ubuntu-22.04.qcow2" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: template image $IMAGES/tpl-ubuntu-22.04.qcow2 not found" >&2
  exit 1
fi

WORKDIR="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$WORKDIR"' EXIT

# Cloud-init user-data rendered by Infrahub (see the vm-userdata artifact).
cat > "$WORKDIR/user-data" <<'CLOUDINIT'
#cloud-config
# VM: fra1-vm-cache01 (Linux guest - cloud-init)
hostname: fra1-vm-cache01
manage_etc_hosts: true
users:
  - name: admin
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    shell: /bin/bash
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAA demo@opsmill
packages:
  - qemu-guest-agent
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable --now qemu-guest-agent
CLOUDINIT

cat > "$WORKDIR/meta-data" <<METADATA
instance-id: fra1-vm-cache01
local-hostname: fra1-vm-cache01
METADATA

cloud-localds "$IMAGES/fra1-vm-cache01-seed.iso" "$WORKDIR/user-data" "$WORKDIR/meta-data"

cp "$IMAGES/tpl-ubuntu-22.04.qcow2" "$IMAGES/fra1-vm-cache01.qcow2"
qemu-img resize "$IMAGES/fra1-vm-cache01.qcow2" 80G

virt-install \
  --name "fra1-vm-cache01" \
  --vcpus 4 \
  --memory 8192 \
  --disk "$IMAGES/fra1-vm-cache01.qcow2,bus=virtio" \
  --disk "$IMAGES/fra1-vm-cache01-seed.iso,device=cdrom" \
  --network bridge=br0,model=virtio \
  --os-variant ubuntu22.04 \
  --import \
  --noautoconsole

# Status is "provisioning" - shut the VM down after first-boot import.
virsh shutdown "fra1-vm-cache01" || true
